drafts.title: Free
drafts.pitch: Same idea told straight: Null paints FREE, Cursor asks free what, Null stares, Tilde says the sign isn't the thing.
drafts.reason: Clean and faithful to the pitch, but it ends on Tilde's line with no button, so it reads as a setup and one punch.

drafts.title: Free What
drafts.pitch: Same idea as a callback to No Bell: Null repaints the shop's price to FREE, and after Tilde's line says it's a very good sign.
drafts.reason: The sign already lists portraits, songs and renders, so 'Free what?' stops making sense, and Cursor's 'You lowered the price!' contradicts it.
